title: Add bounded refinement controller

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python-v1 bounded refinement-controller capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: Reuse the current-head LogicPredictionCEGIS@1 bounded counterexample-guided refinement controller rather than introduce a PCSM wrapper or second refinement authority. Its versioned bounds cap rounds, goals, subgoals, premises, counterexamples, repeated states, residual gaps, context, wall time, CPU time, and memory; policy may tighten but not exceed hard ceilings. The controller is monotonic, content-addresses state and terminal receipts, preserves original goals/facets, terminates repeated states and cycles, returns typed residual feedback for bound/cancellation outcomes, and permits hypothesis narrowing only from replayed validation or a proof of negation. Raw solver and model material remains diagnostic-only. No PCSM source-map, solver, proof, mutation, completion, M2, or M3 authority was created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The reusable controller and direct positive/negative tests are current-head and pass in the sealed validation environment, but no canonical aggregate PCSM SourceLinkReceipt/source-map CID binds this named forest's concrete goals, hypotheses, facets, premises, countermodels, or refinement campaign. This receipt therefore reports a bounded generic capability and intentionally does not invent a PCSM controller request/result CID, source-map CID, proof result, or promotion.

A PCSM wrapper, separate loop, second state identity, or competing receipt schema would exceed this receipt-only dispatch and duplicate authority.

components.role: Deterministic bounded controller over program-logic goals, hypotheses, premises, subgoals, countermodels, and residual gaps; it content-addresses terminal receipts and fail-closes authority violations.
Versioned policy bounds with hard ceilings; it controls rounds, state growth, evidence volume, context, wall/CPU time, and memory.
Versioned identity-bearing state, round, and terminal-receipt contracts that preserve originals, detect cycles, bind outcomes, and produce typed residual feedback.

determinism_and_binding.identity: State and terminal receipt identities derive from canonical content; the direct suite verifies deterministic replay is identity-equivalent and dictionary round trips preserve contracts.
determinism_and_binding.bounded_control: The controller enforces policy-tightenable hard ceilings and terminates on fixed point, resolved hypotheses, repeated state, cycle, max rounds, resource/context exhaustion, cancellation, timeout, no progress, authority violation, or inconclusive input.
determinism_and_binding.authority_boundary: Raw solver countermodels may drive diagnostic retrieval only. Hypothesis rejection/narrowing requires a validation receipt replayed against originating LogicIR semantics or a proof of negation. Model-proposed decomposition and unauthorized premises fail closed; the controller does not execute solvers, mutate source, admit predictions, grant completion, or promote results.

source_inventory.role: Current-head LogicPredictionCEGIS@1 implementation, versioned bounds/state/round/receipt schemas, identity binding, authority checks, and bounded termination.
Direct positive and negative bounded-controller tests.
Underlying module reached by the required PCSM suite; recorded separately and never relabelled as bounded-refinement integration coverage.

focused_bounded_refinement_validation.command: PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin HOME=<fresh ipfs-accelerate-validation-home-pcsm075-focus-*> XDG_CACHE_HOME=$HOME/.cache XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/.config XDG_DATA_HOME=$HOME/.local/share XDG_STATE_HOME=$HOME/.local/state PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=ipfs_accelerate_py /usr/bin/python3.12 -m pytest -q test/api/test_agent_supervisor_logic_prediction_cegis.py
focused_bounded_refinement_validation.environment: Authoritative sealed Python 3.12.3 with pytest 8.1.1, prescribed PATH, fresh private HOME/XDG root, user-site disabled, and accelerator source only on PYTHONPATH.
positive_coverage: Policy bounds tighten under hard ceilings; originals/facets remain monotonic; validated replay or proof-of-negation evidence can refine hypotheses; authorized subgoal refinement preserves the original goal; residual gaps feed tactician feedback; and deterministic replay is identity-equivalent.
Repeated states/cycles terminate, max rounds and counterexamples yield typed bound exhaustion with residuals, resource accounting is enforced, cancellation is typed, and schemas round-trip.
negative_coverage: Original goals cannot be dropped; raw or cross-root solver countermodels remain diagnostic-only; diagnostic receipts cannot eliminate hypotheses; model decomposition without authority, decomposition without a refinement proof, unauthorized premise addition, and re-adding an excluded premise are rejected.
Bounds above hard ceilings and invalid memory measurement fail closed rather than weakening policy or accepting an unmeasured campaign.
focused_bounded_refinement_validation.scope_limit: These are controlled generic LogicIR/controller fixtures. They establish the reusable contract only; they do not run a concrete current-PCSM source-map-bound refinement campaign, solver, or proof.
